title: run-outcome
description: How an agent workflow run ended, saved as the artifact `run-outcome` (file run-outcome.json, 30 days) by every agent workflow (Story 4.4, AD-5). Consumers: n8n's cap count (Story 5.6) and W1 (Story 5.5). Status words for people come from vocabulary.json run_outcome.

ticket_key.description: Jira key, or empty when the run has no ticket (for example triage).

reason.description: Machine reason, for example cases-not-merged; empty when status is ok.
